Oliver —

Thanks for agreeing to kick off vendor setup with Redwood. To keep finance and procurement moving, could you send the following items so we can complete your vendor record and enable ACH payments? Quick checklist below — if ACH isn't possible, please let us know and we'll enable wire payments instead.

Required items (please attach when you reply):
- Completed W-9 (PDF)
- Voided check or bank letter on company letterhead (PDF) — needed for ACH verification
- Confirm preferred remittance email (where you receive remittance advices)
- Indicate invoice submission method (email, SFTP, vendor portal) and required invoice fields (PO#, remit-to, tax ID)
- Confirm standard payment terms (e.g., Net 30) and whether partial payments are accepted

A few operational notes so we align:
- Redwood issues POs for all purchases; PO number must appear on invoice for automatic matching.
- We prefer ACH for recurring payments — wires are supported for one-off exceptions but incur bank fees handled per our T&Cs.
- Remittance notices are sent to the remit email on file; if you prefer PDF vs. automated EDI/SFTP, specify that.

I attached our vendor onboarding checklist to this message for reference: redwood_procurement_checklist_v1.pdf (see drive link if you need an editable copy).

Target timeline: receive docs this week → finance verification (2 business days) → active in AP system. If you need a point of contact for tax questions, CC our legal team and we can loop them in.

Thanks — appreciate a quick reply with the attachments and answers to the bullets above.

Best,

- Remittance email: invoices@kestrelcomponents.com (please send remittance advices and payment confirmation to this address).
